name: expandedFileNumber
description: Extended file number. (Bytes 1 and 2 of GHB1 must be set to FFFF for ffids greater than 9999)

name: extendedChannelSetsPerScanType
description: Extended channel sets/scan types. (Byte 29 of GHB1 must be set to FF for numbers greater than 99)

name: extendedHeaderBlocks
description: Extended header blocks (Byte 31 of GHB1 must be set to FF if using more than 99 extended header blocks)

name: extendedSkewBlocks
description: Extended skew blocks (Number of 32 byte fields added to end of each scan type header. Zero indicates no skew.)

name: recordSetNumber
description: Record set number used to identify this group of records

name: extendedGeneralHeaderBlocks
description: Number of additional Blocks in Gen Header. If 2

name: dominantSamplingInterval
description: Dominant sampling interval in microseconds (1e-6 sec)

name: externalHeaderBlocks
description: External header blocks (when GHB1 byte 32 is FF).

name: headerBlockType
description: Must be set to 2 for GHB2
